name: toast
title: Toast
description: A short message that slides in at the bottom right and fades after a few seconds. Also an inline alert for messages that stay on the page.
whenToUse: Toast: confirm an action that happened ('Saved', 'Submitted for approval'). Alert: a message that must stay visible (validation summary, warning about data).

variants.description: JavaScript call; tone is success, danger, info or warning.

a11y: The toast region is aria-live="polite". Alerts that need immediate attention use role="alert".
